research_scope: Manually reviewed public competitor sources for the 3 already analyzed websites; no claim of generic real-time external source search inside the live FastAPI endpoint.
methodology: Match established business category of submitted domain and real vendor product category.
Corroborate each name and core product capability with its own official product/help page.
For market overlap, cross-check with a comparative editorial article; editorial may have commercial/affiliate incentives.
Avoid fabricated prices, rankings, ROI, speed, defect rates and untested comparative strengths/weaknesses.
The current API may return AI suggestions tagged unverified; this source catalog is a separate independently assembled research artifact and does not silently replace LLM results.
